topic: The "tough reviewer" prompt: give Claude a role and let it poke holes in your draft before your boss does
post:
Want feedback on your work before your boss sees it? 🧐
Ask Claude to play the toughest reviewer in the room.

Anthropic's prompting guide says giving Claude a role focuses its behavior and tone, and even a single sentence makes a difference.

So instead of "Is this good?" (which often gets you a polite yes), give it a job.

Copy-paste prompt 👇

"Act as a skeptical senior manager reviewing this [proposal / email / plan]. List the 3 biggest weaknesses, the questions you'd ask me in the meeting, and one change that would make it stronger. Be direct and specific. Don't rewrite it for me."

Try it on:
📄 A project proposal
📧 An email to a client
📊 A budget request
🎤 Your talking points for a big meeting

Why "don't rewrite it"? ✍️
You stay the author. Claude shows you the gaps, and you decide what to fix.

Why it matters:
The best time to hear the hard questions is before the meeting, not during it. This prompt gives you a practice round. 💡

What's the next thing you'd run past your AI reviewer? 👇

Follow me: I'm teaching one Claude skill a day, no tech background needed.
